description: This file defines a report parser class for generating cost ledger reports related to analytic accounts in Odoo, including methods for calculating sums, retrieving lines, and handling revenue calculations.

classes.name: account_analytic_cost_ledger
classes.description: Report parser class for cost ledger, providing methods to fetch and compute analytic account data for reporting.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context with methods and variables.

methods.name: _lines_g
methods.description: Fetches analytic account lines grouped by account, calculating debit and credit based on balance.

methods.name: _lines_a
methods.description: Fetches detailed analytic line entries with revenue calculations, updating total revenue sums.

methods.name: _account_sum_debit
methods.description: Calculates total debit for an account within a date range.

methods.name: _account_sum_credit
methods.description: Calculates total credit for an account within a date range.

methods.name: _account_sum_balance
methods.description: Calculates net balance (debit minus credit) for an account.

methods.name: _account_sum_qty
methods.description: Calculates total quantity for an account within a date range.

methods.name: _account_sum_revenue
methods.description: Retrieves total revenue for an account.

methods.name: _account_g_sum_revenue
methods.description: Retrieves total revenue for a general account.

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Sums debit amounts over multiple accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Sums credit amounts over multiple accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_balance
methods.description: Calculates net balance over multiple accounts.

methods.name: _sum_revenue
methods.description: Calculates total revenue over multiple accounts.
